notes.title: The Visceral Update!
notes.content:
[h2]🎯THE VISCERAL UPDATE!🎯[/h2]
Thanks to our incredible community, we're rolling out a BIG update that brings even more excitement to NO RELOADING: Survival Trials! Let’s dive into the highlights!

[h2]💥SPECTACULAR VISUAL UPGRADES!💥[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/22644c085b82717f9ec9df1ce06b5b6111612ec3.png[/img]
Your destruction has never looked so beautiful. We've amped up the visuals to make every hit feel incredible:
[list][*]New "gore" effects: enemies burst into satisfying crystalline bits leaving glittery debris everywhere!
[*]Epic muzzle flashes like your favorite action movies!
[*]Camera now subtly reacts to gunfire and strafing.  This tiny change dramatically increases the cinematic feel of combat!
[*]Yellow hit marker now appears on crosshair for clearer feedback!
[*]Roger's tractor beam limbs now "pop" more thanks to clever outlining; otherwise sometimes it looked like Roger was losing his legs!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/413e1533cc504f7cb6b49b9f4dd5b56c66d0703a.png[/img][/list]

[h2]🎁NEW FREE AUGMENTS!🎁[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/a1a097a1d26e1116ff71a93a7b640bef87600440.png[/img]
We've made some of your favorite abilities and augments into FREE augments, meaning more choices per run without burning a level-up! This adds even more customization to your playstyle.
[list][*]All improvements to existing augments are now free!
[*]Super Jump: Soar to new heights!
[*]Steal: Yank weapons right out of enemy's hands!
[*]Fast Fall: Land faster, reload quicker!
[*]Disarm: Shoot enemy's weapons right out of their hands, coming straight to you!
[*]Chrono-Gaze: Slow down time like a true gunslinger!
[*]Gundar: Master the art of scavenging!
[*]Compass: Never get lost again!
[*]Grab Range: Pick up things across the room!
[*]Kick Range: Kick enemies across the room too!
[*]Reset Kick Cooldown: Unleash non-stop melee attacks!
[*]And more![/list]

[h2]🌟QUALITY OF LIFE UPDATES🌟[/h2]
We’ve packed in a ton of improvements to make gameplay smoother than ever!
[list][*]Color-coded pick-up notifications now appear in the top-left like classic FPS games, showing weapons, ammo, XP, etc.

[*]Starting pistols and chests now also available in the Hub room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/f0528600747cd7776475f95962f6d32c1e3492bd.png[/img]
[*]Roger no longer freezes when depleting a slide; keep that momentum going!
[*]De-janked brutal mode's confusing hub teleporter.
[/list]

[h2]🐛BUG FIXES🐛[/h2]
A smoother experience awaits with these critical bug fixes:
[list][*]Fixed funky legs on Roger in the main menu.
[*]Collectibles Found stat now correctly counts.
[*]Many more I neglected to take note of, haha![/list]

[h2]☕JUST GETTING STARTED!☕[/h2]
We’re just scratching the surface! There’s so much more coming, so be sure to share your epic moments and feedback in our [url=https://discord.gg/AMTKx9R]Discord community[/url]. Keep slaying, survivors! If you’re particularly awesome, I might even add a collectible in your honor!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/eef3341951c23e1dbbc27a1d10cccfd6d1e12db5.png[/img]

notes.title: The Theme Update!
notes.content:
[h2]🔥NEW UPDATES🔥[/h2]
Thanks to our playtesters on Discord, I have been busily improving NO RELOADING: Survival Trials!

[h2]🖼️THEME SELECTION!🖼️[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/231dd625d78b1138d52507b32d5e04ac637a988f.png[/img]
After playing a short while, new players will now be prompted to choose their preferred visual theme!  
[list][*] STANDARD: 90s Nostalgia!  Slightly pixelated and has "Roger vision" edge detection.
[*] SLICK: Clean and modern for that classic pretty low poly look.
[/list]
Players may choose overall theme, or fiddle with specific aspects, in Options at any time.

It will be fun to see which theme players prefer!  Tell me your preference in our [url=https://discord.gg/AMTKx9R]Discord community[/url]!

[h2]⏫NEW AUGMENTS⏫[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41607901/24a76f494960048ad8861fa80c60d884dcb6ce21.png[/img]
[list][*]Ammunition Conversion: Allows weapons to use incompatible ammunition types!
[*]Heal on Scavenge: Scavenging ammunition heals!
[*]Nom Nom Nom: Picking up non-weapons consumes them, healing you significantly!
[*]Auto-Equip: Automatically pick up a specific weapon type to your left or right hand.
[*]Augment Preference: Increase the chances to see augments for a particular ability.
[*]Added Lone Ranger augment to Gunslinger.[/list]

[h2]✨POLISH✨[/h2]
[list][*]Added dithering slider in graphical options.
[*]Added pixel size slider in graphical options.
[*]Polished the standard retro aesthetic a bit.[/list]

[h2]🐛BUG FIXES🐛[/h2]
[list][*]Enemies traveling under floor in Pool Room.[/list]

[h2]☕JUST GETTING STARTED!☕[/h2]
Remember to share your love, suggestions, and epic moments in our [url=https://discord.gg/AMTKx9R]Discord community[/url]. Happy gaming!  If you're particularly impactful, I will add a collectible to the game in your honor!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/eef3341951c23e1dbbc27a1d10cccfd6d1e12db5.png[/img]

notes.title: Streamer Mode Insanity Updates and Much More!
notes.content:
I've been hard at work adding thrilling updates of NO RELOADING: Survival Trials. Experience enhanced gameplay, thrilling new features, and crucial fixes for an unbeatable stylish rogue-lite experience!

[h2]🎮Streamer Mode Enhancements🎮[/h2]
[list][*][b]New Viewer Commands[/b]: Enrich your streaming experience with a range of new viewer commands like spawning skeletons and applying buffs to enemies!  Answer the streamer mode trivia questions in game to learn all the commands!
[*][b]Viewer Votes[/b]: Viewers can now vote to spawn hordes, drop rare weapons chests, disarm Roger, reload Roger's guns, despawn all nearby weapons, and much more.[/list]

[h2]🔥New Features🔥[/h2]
[list][*][b]Crosshair Status Indicator[/b]: Stay informed with a new crosshair showing the state of reverse projectiles, gunslinger, gun-kata, shoot dodge, cartwheel, and more.
[*][b]Shortcut Teleporters[/b]: Access later episodes faster with new shortcut teleporters, making your journey through the trials more dynamic.  Kill bosses to gain the teleporter keys!
[*][b]Enhanced Run Stats[/b]: Track your progress with best, last, and average stats tracking.[/list]

[h2]👾Polish and User Interface Improvements👾[/h2]
[list][*][b]World-space Controls Update[/b]: Improved the display of left and right controls text for better clarity.
[*][b]Limited Computer Interaction Angles[/b]: Was mighty confusing to try to use the in-game computer at extreme angles![/list]

[h2]🎯Balance and Gameplay Adjustments🎯[/h2]
[list][*][b]New Player Balance[/b]: Adjusted difficulty for new players, offering a smoother learning curve.
[*][b]Mushba Anticipation[/b]: Increased anticipation time for Mushba's attacks for better player response.
[*][b]Player Speed Rarity[/b]: Increased the likelihood of speed augment drops, enhancing mobility and agility.[/list]

[h2]🛠Bug Fixes🛠[/h2]
[list][*][b]Throwing Mechanics[/b]: Adjusted maximum throw power to prevent throwing through walls.
[*][b]Keybind Text Updates[/b]: Fixed an issue where keybind texts weren't updating upon changes.
[*][b]Skeleton Animations[/b]: Resolved floating skeletons issue to ensure natural enemy movements.
[*][b]Camera Polish[/b]: Finally fixed the forever-old looking up/down spin problem![/list]

[h2]We're Just Getting Started![/h2]
Stay tuned for more updates, tweaks, and thrilling additions. Your journey through Survival Trials is evolving - are you ready for the next level of action?

Remember to share your feedback, suggestions, and epic moments in our [url=https://discord.gg/AMTKx9R]Discord community[/url]. Happy gaming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/eef3341951c23e1dbbc27a1d10cccfd6d1e12db5.png[/img]

notes.title: The Difficulty Shake-Up Update
notes.content:
We're shaking things up! Brace yourself for more balance, more control, more variety, and yes, new difficulty levels! Here's a speedy rundown of what's fresh:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]Choose Your Battle: Normal, Hard, and Brutal difficulties added - get ready to choose your own adventure!
[*]Brutal Mode Mix-up: Campaign order shuffled in Brutal mode for the ultimate variety spice![/list]
[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list][*]Cooler Guns, Cooler Rules: Miniguns are rarer, but tougher, and with a ramping fire rate for that added drama!
[*]Enemy Spawns: Now a bit less hectic in Highway, with brighter street lamps for better avoidance.
Reinforcements Pull Back: Enemies less likely to spawn while you grab those upgrade orbs.
[*]Augment Chances: Auto-scavenger augment boosted - finding this gem is now easier![/list]
[h1]Polish[/h1]
[list][*]Roger Chats More: Now our favorite bot gets chatty when his weapon breaks.
[*]Upgrade Choices UI: Sleek new look for easier navigation![/list]
[h1]Bugs Squashed[/h1]
[list][*]No Self-Inflicted Damage: Your sword can't hit your shield anymore, phew!
[*]Fixed Projectile Overload: The minigun only shoots one projectile per shot now, as it should![/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/eef3341951c23e1dbbc27a1d10cccfd6d1e12db5.png[/img]
We're continually working on improving your survival trials! Keep those guns blazing, champions!

(This news was published about a week late!  What can we say?  Work'n hard!)

notes.title: 🏹 THE HEAVY UPDATE: Crossbows, Mouse Hordes (!?) & More! 🐁
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/8cddf3f5a9c13ea70496cd5ea38e709afb1cb4d5.png[/img]🔥 Time to gear up! NO RELOADING: Survival Trials is back with an explosive update that will blow your circuits! Your training montage is now juicier, meaner, and packed with even more adrenaline-pumping action. Grab your weapons and dive into the frenzy! 🎮

[h1]🎖 The Ultimate Survival Trials 🎖[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/d9c6aa3b242be9e5f34a03fd7495610d67b82b77.png[/img]We've overhauled the Survival Trials for a more challenging and gratifying experience. Say hello to distinct chapters, each ten levels deep, ending in intense boss fights. Journey your way through themed chapters like the Proving Grounds, Ancient Times, and Modern Times. Face off against ferocious enemies as you delve deeper into each chapter. Oh, and did we mention, there’s a heap of new rooms like the epic Castle, and the majestic Greek Temple? 😎

[h1]👾 Enemies on Steroids! 👾[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/2c7339b755c4cdc4906e047f67bd76884c9e56ac.png[/img]Get ready to face the hordes! Enemies are now smarter, diversified, and more relentless. Heavies join the fray with extra hit points and resistance, dropping double the loot. Watch out for rampaging minions, including the fearsome mouse bot, with heightened senses, and, rumor has it, they have learned how to search for you! 😱
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/96f3f5d62a1570bb88751d7619efc41168d4dbdb.png[/img]

[h1]🌟 Polished to Mirror Sheen! 🌟[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/2d170afd8da89c6167ece18f620969f4d14e6392.png[/img]Experience the glory of the new and improved environmental reflections – they’re so darn pretty! And of course, we've done away with various pesky music and visual bugs for a seamless battle symphony. 🎶

[h1]🌈 Pick-ups & Upgrades Bonanza! 🌈[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/0afd5a55d0070a92470b5ad567dd9058efa317df.png[/img]Up your game with dazzling pick-ups and upgrades. Introducing Rare Weapon Chests and snazzy ammunition pick-ups, so you’ll always be prepared for the next fight! If you’re lucky, you may even find the infamous MINIGUN! The upgrade window is smarter and shows how many pending upgrades await, and level-ups queue up and won’t interrupt your killer combos. It’s raining upgrades and they’re all yours! 💰

[h1]🏹 Enter the Crossbow! 🏹[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/47d877de8418b2d1d51bd58423cc3679a3942efe.png[/img]Unleash the fury of the brand new crossbow! Precise, deadly, and just plain awesome - this new weapon is set to redefine your combat tactics. Get your hands on it and let the bolts fly! 🎯

[h1]🌟 Shoutouts & Thanks! 🌟[/h1]
[url=https://discord.gg/AMTKx9R][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/19c50d350abca7542bfe58d69df9042fe8c0aa26.png[/img][/url]Our heartfelt thanks to the community, especially @lackofwords, @Zorder, @Fqed, @LumpyLatino, and @AngryWorm for your invaluable feedback. We couldn’t have done this without you! 📢

[h1]🚀What are you waiting for?💣[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/eef3341951c23e1dbbc27a1d10cccfd6d1e12db5.png[/img]  Jump into NO RELOADING: Survival Trials and experience the onslaught like never before! This is the ultimate showdown, and only the toughest will survive. Don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769060/NO_RELOADING_Survival_Trials/]wishlist[/url] the game on Steam and [url=https://discord.gg/AMTKx9R]share your training montages[/url] with us! 🔫

[i]Themes, rooms, and enemies will continue to be expanded and adjusted in the future. Stay tuned![/i]
